title: SDLC ROI Case Study Workbench
creator: Katie Jo Schuman
subject: AI economics
description: The learner will calculate the year 1 costs, benefit, net, ROI, and break-even realization of the 20-engineer SDLC case, to within $1 for dollar values and 0.1 percentage points for percentages.

learningObjectives: The learner will calculate the year 1 costs, benefit, net, ROI, and break-even realization of the 20-engineer SDLC case, to within $1 for dollar values and 0.1 percentage points for percentages.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit-then-explore: predict, receive feedback, then explore
commonMisconceptions: (1) The tool licence is the main cost of an AI coding assistant. (2) The ROI depends mainly on how fast the tool is. (3) A positive gross saving implies a positive ROI.
assessmentOpportunities: For each of eight items the learner types a value before the answer is shown. A value is correct when it is within the tolerance stated above. Mastery is 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt. Exploration with the adjustable quantities is not evidence.
